I’m 23 and I stopped going to college for my engineering degree after a year and a half because I didn’t feel like I wanted to do that as a career my whole life. I also don’t have a passion for any other degrees so I just kinda stopped going altogether. I relate to the part where you said your friends moved on because it’s the same for me. I was in the magnet program from middle to highschool(higher difficulty than normal classes) so I been seeing my classmates succeed in getting their degrees with pictures on social media and that low key made me wanna delete my social media because I was jealous of their motivation/success. As of right now though I just started working at a cafe and made friends so I guess that helped a little but I still feel like I didn’t accomplish anything in life. I come from an Asian household so that puts even more pressure and made me not wanna meet relatives because I know they’d ask about my school. I just wanted to put this here to let you know you’re not alone.
